remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: {{name}} loses access to the network immediately and its key is revoked. To use it again you will have to add it as a new device. This cannot be undone.
remove.failed: {{name}} was not removed. Try again in a moment.

downloads.title: Download apps
downloads.description: Install an app on the device, then add it here.
downloads.notPublished: NeroNet for {{platform}} is not published yet. Use the WireGuard app for now.
downloads.ios: On iPhone and iPad, install the official WireGuard app, then scan the code from Add a device.
downloads.wireguard: The official WireGuard app works on every platform with the code from Add a device.

link.desktop: WireGuard for Windows, macOS and Linux

add.title: Add a device
add.description: Create the access code for one phone or computer; it is made on this page and shown once.
add.step1: Install the WireGuard app on the device.
add.step2: Give the device a name and create its code.
add.step3: Scan the code with the app, or import the file.
add.name: Device name
add.nameRequired: Enter a name of 1 to 64 characters.

result.title: Scan this code with the WireGuard app
result.warning: This code holds the device's private key and is shown only once; anyone who scans it can use your access.

error.noGateway: Your organisation cannot add devices this way yet. An administrator has to choose the gateway in Settings.
error.keyInUse: The new key was already in use. Create the code again.
error.generic: The device was not added. Try again.
error.noCrypto: This browser cannot create the keys. Open this page in a current version of Chrome, Firefox, Safari or Edge.

strict.title: Networks that block VPNs (port 443)
strict.intro: For computers. Some networks, such as those in hotels, offices and guest Wi-Fi, let only the web through. With this method the connection goes over port 443, like a website, but it is slower: use it only when the code above does not connect.
strict.run: Start this command and leave it open while you stay connected:
strict.import: Import this second file into the WireGuard app and turn it on instead of the first one. It uses the same keys but goes through the command above.
strict.download: Download the file for blocked networks
strict.secret: The command contains an address reserved for your organisation: do not publish it or share it outside your team.
strict.phones: On iPhone and Android the WireGuard app cannot use this method.
